_comment: DRAFT (dialogue-drafts lane 2026-07-06, NOT wired). 'The Antler Order' — hermit-alchemist give-beat + three-path resolutions. Spec: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-07-06-home-region-content-2-design.md §2/§4. Voice contract: character-profiles-staging.md 'The hermit-alchemist' (short declaratives, barter-ethics, never asks questions twice). Speaker name 'Sorven' = ORIGINAL+flag. Wiring notes + canon cites: hermit_antler_order.md.

hub.speaker: Sorven
hub.text: You found the garden. Most give up at the third wrong hill. If you carry the Guild package, set it on the stump. Not the roots.

text_variants.text: The glassware holds. So does the offer, if you want work.
The order stands. Shed antler, freely dropped. The herd walks the north field.
The still runs hot this week. Your doing. Good doing.

options.text: Delivery from the Runner's Guild. One package, marked for the hermit.
About Krshia's trade — I'd need that remedy of yours.
Shed antler. Gathered off the ground at first light.
Krshia's stock. She took the remedy — says her knees are a war older than her pride.

delivery.speaker: Sorven
delivery.text: Glassware. Whole, for once. The fee went to the Guild; the thanks goes to you — two gold for careful hands. There is other work here, if you want it. Antler work.

offer.speaker: Sorven
offer.text: Corusdeer. The herd walks the north floodplain — you'll know them at dusk, the antlers hold their ember. I need antler for the winter stills, and the kind matters. Antler freely shed carries the year in it. Antler taken carries the taking. I pay for the FIRST kind.

pay_terms.speaker: Sorven
pay_terms.text: Twelve gold for shed. Four for taken — Guild rate, no better. My nose knows the difference. Friction wakes a corusdeer antler; a shed one wakes warm, a taken one wakes angry.

accepted.speaker: Sorven
accepted.text: Three roads to it. The herd sheds at a ground past the east rise — go at dawn, the drops show pale against the frost-kill. Krshia Silverfang stocks shed antler some seasons; she wants my joint-remedy more than my coin. Or you kill one. I said I pay less for that. I meant it.

remedy.speaker: Sorven
remedy.text: Willowbark, shed velvet, three winters of practice. Her knees will know the difference by morning. Trade fair — she will.

resolution_shed.speaker: Sorven
resolution_shed.text: Warm at the tips still. That's the year in it. Pack them apart when you carry — friction wakes them, and a pack fire teaches that lesson once. Twelve gold. The stills thank you. So do I.

resolution_traded.speaker: Sorven
resolution_traded.text: Silverfang-kept. Dry, clean, no taking in them. Ten gold — two went to the trade, in a manner of counting. Fair both ways. That's the best kind of deal: the kind nobody brags about.

resolution_taken.speaker: Sorven
resolution_taken.text: Taken. ...Four gold. Guild rate. I said I pay for the first kind — I also said I pay. A thing can be worth less and still be worth something. The herd runs thinner at dusk now. You'll notice. That isn't me talking. That's the field.

options.text: I'd do it differently next time.

taken_coda.speaker: Sorven
taken_coda.text: Then you learned the year's lesson at autumn prices. Cheap enough. The stills don't care. I do, a little. It passes.
